name: GCSE Physics (AQA 8463) — separate science, Foundation and Higher tier

selected_options.tiers_built: Both Foundation and Higher, consistent with the other GCSE sciences and Mathematics
selected_options.pathway_note: This is the separate-science route (full Physics GCSE, 8463), distinct from the Physics content within Combined Science: Trilogy. It includes Physics-only content such as static electricity, moments, pressure in fluids, momentum changes, lenses, black-body radiation, loudspeakers, microphones, transformers and space physics.

material_vintage: AQA GCSE Physics (8463) specification (first teaching 2016, current and live). Subject-content codes 4.1.1.1-4.8.2.1, the 10 required practicals, Working scientifically WS1-WS4 (section 3) and the Mathematical requirements (section 7) were itemised on 2026-09-19 from AQA's specification pages and PDF. Section 4.8 Space physics and the 4.7 subsection list were completed from the AQA published structure and flagged for re-verification against the live page. Stage test scenarios are original questions written in the style of AQA papers, not real past-paper items.
level_source: RQF Level 2 (GCSE, full grade range 1-9 / Foundation+Higher tiers covered), per Ofqual's Register of Regulated Qualifications listing for this specification
